objective: Turn selected broad candidate searches into an auditable discovery-to-ledger set reconciliation so surfaced matter roots cannot disappear behind a syntactically closed ledger.

debugger/tasks/task-d6d62c8aa5b20d8654f1/result.json: decisive source paths appeared in discovery but were lost during reconciliation
changes.failure_pattern: Candidate-generating search results were indistinguishable from neutral census or incidental-search output, so no deterministic state mechanism could preserve their matter roots across later free-form ledger rewrites.
changes.mechanism: Glob and grep now accept a validated candidate_discovery boolean and echo it in page metadata, allowing the agent to designate only high-precision, corpus-rooted result pages whose matter roots must be dispositioned.
changes.rationale: The discovery tools are the earliest surface that knows both the search intent and exact returned paths; adding an explicit designation there avoids guessing legal relevance from filenames in middleware.

changes.rationale: Because tool descriptions are delivered with the structured schema, they place the designation rule at the exact call-decision point without lengthening every named-file workflow.
